crossRefs.note: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in…
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

translations.web: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
translations.bsb: But the king of the Ammonites paid no heed to the message Jephthah sent him.
translations.kjv: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent
translations.asv: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
